name: The Biltmore Hotel Villas

address.street: The Biltmore Hotel Villas - Al Barsha - Al Barsha 1 - Dubai - United Arab Emirates

insider_take: A hidden gem where old-world Miami glamour meets modern luxury in the heart of Coral Gables
whats_special: The Biltmore's iconic 315-foot tower, visible from miles away, was once the tallest building in Florida when it opened in 1926. The hotel's massive lagoon-style pool is one of the largest hotel pools in the continental US, fed by natural artesian wells. Hollywood royalty like Judy Garland and Bing Crosby made this their playground during Miami's golden age.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner at Palme d'Or - the restaurant's terrace offers unobstructed views of the illuminated Biltmore tower, creating an Instagram-worthy backdrop that most guests never discover.
dont_miss: The weekly Sunday champagne brunch with live jazz in the Cortile, and the complimentary historical tours that reveal the hotel's fascinating past as a WWII military hospital. Golf enthusiasts should experience the championship course that hosted PGA tournaments in the 1930s.
pros: Luxury villa-style accommodations with private pools and spacious layouts
Prime Dubai location with easy access to major attractions and business districts
Leading Hotels of the World prestige and exceptional service standards
Resort-like amenities and facilities in an urban setting
cons: Villa-style layout may require more walking between facilities
